directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.EN: a bloodsucker was noticed.
entries.JA_current: a bloodsucker was noticed.
entries.JA_new: ブラッドサッカーが目撃された。

entries.EN: an army heli was seen loitering. Another raid is to be expected, most probably...
entries.JA_current: an army heli was seen loitering. Another raid is to be expected, most probably...
entries.JA_new: 軍のヘリが上空を旋回していた。また襲撃が来るかもしれない。おそらくな……

entries.EN: a military helicopter was seen shooting at somebody and then flying away. Stay alert.
entries.JA_current: a military helicopter was seen shooting at somebody and then flying away. Stay alert.
entries.JA_new: 軍用ヘリが誰かを撃って飛び去るのを見た。警戒しろ。

entries.EN: a military heli was noticed flying north.
entries.JA_current: a military heli was noticed flying north.
entries.JA_new: 軍用ヘリが北へ飛んでいくのを見た。

entries.EN: military radio transmission was intercepted. They plan some raids in a number of regions. Stay alert.
entries.JA_current: military radio transmission was intercepted. They plan some raids in a number of regions. Stay alert.
entries.JA_new: 軍の無線を傍受した。何か所かで襲撃を計画してるらしい。警戒しろ。

entries.EN: soldiers' radio talks were intercepted. Another raid at Agroprom is to follow soon. It is sure to be a failure, but don't poke in there for some time.
entries.JA_current: soldiers' radio talks were intercepted. Another raid at Agroprom is to follow soon. It is sure to be a failure, but don't poke in there for some time.
entries.JA_new: 兵士の無線を傍受した。間もなくアフロプロムを襲撃するらしい。どうせ失敗するだろうが、しばらく近づくな。

entries.EN: the jarheads started a clean-up operation.
entries.JA_current: the jarheads started a clean-up operation.
entries.JA_new: 軍が掃討作戦を始めた。

entries.EN: the fuckin' military started a clean-up operation. Stay outta there.
entries.JA_current: the fuckin' military started a clean-up operation. Stay outta there.
entries.JA_new: クソッタレの軍が掃討作戦を始めた。近づくな。

entries.EN: some rodents were noticed.
entries.JA_current: some rodents were noticed.
entries.JA_new: 齧歯類を何匹か見かけた。

entries.EN: rodents were seen, keep out.
entries.JA_current: rodents were seen, keep out.
entries.JA_new: 齧歯類を見た。近づくな。

entries.EN: a huge rodent was seen.
entries.JA_current: a huge rodent was seen.
entries.JA_new: 巨大な齧歯類を見た。

entries.EN: a snork almost choked me! I hardly got away!
entries.JA_current: a snork almost choked me! I hardly got away!
entries.JA_new: スノークに首を絞められかけた！　なんとか逃げ切った！

entries.EN: some snorks were noticed. Luckily they didn't notice me.
entries.JA_current: some snorks were noticed. Luckily they didn't notice me.
entries.JA_new: スノークを何匹か見かけた。幸い、向こうには気づかれなかった。

entries.EN: a couple of snorks were seen.
entries.JA_current: a couple of snorks were seen.
entries.JA_new: スノークを2匹ほど見かけた。

entries.EN: some zombies were sighted. A controller may be present in the vicinity.
entries.JA_current: some zombies were sighted. A controller may be present in the vicinity.
entries.JA_new: ゾンビを何体か見た。近くにコントローラーがいるかもしれない。

entries.EN: some strange shadow was noticed. Not a bloodsucker, but who knows. So many monsters around, damn them...
entries.JA_current: some strange shadow was noticed. Not a bloodsucker, but who knows. So many monsters around, damn them...
entries.JA_new: 妙な影を見かけた。ブラッドサッカーじゃなかったが、何だったんだか。怪物だらけで嫌になる……

entries.EN: a fight with bandits took place.
entries.JA_current: a fight with bandits took place.
entries.JA_new: バンディットと交戦した。

entries.EN: some sniper shot at me. Keep your heads down.
entries.JA_current: some sniper shot at me. Keep your heads down.
entries.JA_new: 狙撃手に撃たれた。頭を低くしろ。

entries.EN: a wave of mutants attacked. We hardly managed to shoot them all down. Two of our guys didn't make it...
entries.JA_current: a wave of mutants attacked. We hardly managed to shoot them all down. Two of our guys didn't make it...
entries.JA_new: ミュータントの群れに襲われ、どうにか全滅させた。仲間が2人やられた……

entries.EN: mutants nearly tore us to pieces.
entries.JA_current: mutants nearly tore us to pieces.
entries.JA_new: ミュータントに食いちぎられそうになった。

entries.EN: a decomposed corpse was spotted, turned inside out! I didn't approach to investigate, there may be an anomaly there.
entries.JA_current: a decomposed corpse was spotted, turned inside out! I didn't approach to investigate, there may be an anomaly there.
entries.JA_new: 腐乱死体が見つかった。体の内側がひっくり返ってた！　調べに近づくのはやめた。近くにアノマリーがあるかもしれない。

entries.EN: a withered, bloodless body was found. Bloodsuckers likely have a lair nearby, exercise caution and watch your backs.
entries.JA_current: a withered, bloodless body was found. Bloodsuckers likely have a lair nearby, exercise caution and watch your backs.
entries.JA_new: 干からびて血を抜かれた死体が見つかった。近くにブラッドサッカーの巣があるかもしれない。周囲に気を配れ。

entries.EN: a horrible scream was heard. Don't know if it was human, better keep out of there...
entries.JA_current: a horrible scream was heard. Don't know if it was human, better keep out of there...
entries.JA_new: ひどい叫び声が聞こえた。人間の声かもわからん。近づかないほうがいい……

entries.EN: a stalker, all covered in blood, was seen being dragged around on the ground. Couldn't see what was dragging him, a bloodsucker maybe...
entries.JA_current: a stalker, all covered in blood, was seen being dragged around on the ground. Couldn't see what was dragging him, a bloodsucker maybe...
entries.JA_new: 血まみれのストーカーが地面を引きずられていくのを見た。何に引きずられていたかは見えなかった。ブラッドサッカーかもな……

entries.EN: a pack of dogs was noticed dragging a stalker's corpse into some bushes. Be careful there.
entries.JA_current: a pack of dogs was noticed dragging a stalker's corpse into some bushes. Be careful there.
entries.JA_new: 犬の群れがストーカーの死体を茂みに引きずり込んでいた。気をつけろ。

entries.EN: a skirmish with bandits took place. They're all down.
entries.JA_current: a skirmish with bandits took place. They're all down.
entries.JA_new: バンディットと小競り合いになった。全員片づけた。

entries.EN: we stumbled upon a military patrol and had to shoot in defense. Don't poke around there for a while - reinforcements are sure to follow.
entries.JA_current: we stumbled upon a military patrol and had to shoot in defense. Don't poke around there for a while - reinforcements are sure to follow.
entries.JA_new: 軍のパトロール隊と鉢合わせして、応戦するしかなかった。しばらく近づくな。すぐ増援が来るはずだ。

entries.EN: ran into some military recon patrol and had a fight. All the jarheads were killed. Keep out of there - the military are sure to retaliate.
entries.JA_current: ran into some military recon patrol and had a fight. All the jarheads were killed. Keep out of there - the military are sure to retaliate.
entries.JA_new: 軍の偵察隊と出くわして交戦した。兵士は全員始末した。軍が報復に来るはずだ。近づくな。

entries.EN: a snork was seen tearing a stalker into pieces. Plenty of monsters here, damn...
entries.JA_current: a snork was seen tearing a stalker into pieces. Plenty of monsters here, damn...
entries.JA_new: スノークがストーカーを引き裂くのを見た。怪物だらけで嫌になる……

entries.EN: many new anomalies appeared. Beware!
entries.JA_current: many new anomalies appeared. Beware!
entries.JA_new: アノマリーがあちこちに新しく発生した。気をつけろ！

entries.EN: Folks... Has anybody got some vodka? Any alcohol at all?
entries.JA_current: Folks... Has anybody got some vodka? Any alcohol at all?
entries.JA_new: みんな……誰かウォッカ持ってないか？　酒なら何でもいい。

entries.EN: It really got to me today... It's tearing my soul apart.
entries.JA_current: It really got to me today... It's tearing my soul apart.
entries.JA_new: 今日は参った……心が引き裂かれそうだ。

entries.EN: It makes me sick... Think I'm gonna puke...
entries.JA_current: It makes me sick... Think I'm gonna puke...
entries.JA_new: 気分が悪い……吐きそうだ……

entries.EN: More zombies will appear, for sure...
entries.JA_current: More zombies will appear, for sure...
entries.JA_new: どうせまたゾンビが湧いてくる……

entries.EN: I'm sure somebody ain't gonna make it out today. It really hits the brain hard...
entries.JA_current: I'm sure somebody ain't gonna make it out today. It really hits the brain hard...
entries.JA_new: 今日は誰かが生きて帰れない気がする。頭に響いてつらい……

entries.EN: C'mon guys, we have to keep strong. As soon as it's over - time to hunt for artifacts. Who's coming with me?
entries.JA_current: C'mon guys, we have to keep strong. As soon as it's over - time to hunt for artifacts. Who's coming with me?
entries.JA_new: みんな、気を強く持とう。これが終わったらアーティファクトを探しに行くぞ。一緒に来る奴はいるか？

entries.EN: My friend got zombified a moment ago... Damn it! I told him to keep out!.. Had to shoot him down. Sorry, bro...
entries.JA_current: My friend got zombified a moment ago... Damn it! I told him to keep out!.. Had to shoot him down. Sorry, bro...
entries.JA_new: 友達がさっきゾンビになっちまった……くそっ！　近づくなって言ったのに……撃つしかなかった。すまない、兄弟……

entries.EN: To hell with it! When this is over, I'm going back to the big land. I'd rather spend the rest of my life in jail than put up with shit like this..
entries.JA_current: To hell with it! When this is over, I'm going back to the big land. I'd rather spend the rest of my life in jail than put up with shit like this..
entries.JA_new: もうたくさんだ！　終わったら外の世界に帰る。こんな目に遭うくらいなら、残りの人生を刑務所で過ごすほうがマシだ……

entries.EN: Fuck this Zone and those artifacts! I cannot stand it any longer!
entries.JA_current: Fuck this Zone and those artifacts! I cannot stand it any longer!
entries.JA_new: こんなゾーンもアーティファクトもクソくらえだ！　もう耐えられない！

entries.EN: Damn connection! Malfunctioning all the time!
entries.JA_current: Damn connection! Malfunctioning all the time!
entries.JA_new: 通信め……しょっちゅう調子が悪くなる！

entries.EN: What the hell is wrong with the network?!
entries.JA_current: What the hell is wrong with the network?!
entries.JA_new: ネットワークに何が起きてるんだ？！

entries.EN: The connection is out of service again...
entries.JA_current: The connection is out of service again...
entries.JA_new: また通信が途切れた……

entries.EN: Problems with connection... Again...
entries.JA_current: Problems with connection... Again...
entries.JA_new: また通信障害か……

entries.EN: It's dawning, folks... so beautiful!
entries.JA_current: It's dawning, folks... so beautiful!
entries.JA_new: みんな、夜が明けるぞ……きれいだな！

entries.EN: Day is breaking...
entries.JA_current: Day is breaking...
entries.JA_new: 夜が明けてきた……

entries.EN: Look, guys, it's dawning already. Now's the best time for artifact hunting, all the freaks that roam about at night are sound asleep in their holes.
entries.JA_current: Look, guys, it's dawning already. Now's the best time for artifact hunting, all the freaks that roam about at night are sound asleep in their holes.
entries.JA_new: みんな、もう夜が明けてるぞ。アーティファクト探しには今が一番いい。夜にうろついてる化け物どもも、巣穴でぐっすり寝てる。

entries.EN: It's daylight. Let's move, it's more or less safe now.
entries.JA_current: It's daylight. Let's move, it's more or less safe now.
entries.JA_new: 明るくなった。行こう。今ならまあ安全だ。

entries.EN: Wake up, lads! Morning has come!
entries.JA_current: Wake up, lads! Morning has come!
entries.JA_new: 起きろ、みんな！　朝だぞ！

entries.EN: Hey, lads! It's daylight at last! In case anyone pissed their pants during the night, change them and let's get a move on.
entries.JA_current: Hey, lads! It's daylight at last! In case anyone pissed their pants during the night, change them and let's get a move on.
entries.JA_new: おい、みんな！　やっと明るくなったぞ！　夜中に漏らした奴は着替えて、さっさと出発だ。

entries.EN: Does anybody hear me? A group of our lads appear to be missing. They were supposed to get back from Agroprom by morning, but haven't turned up yet. We're organizing a search in one hour.
entries.JA_current: Does anybody hear me? A group of our lads appear to be missing. They were supposed to get back from Agroprom by morning, but haven't turned up yet. We're organizing a search in one hour.
entries.JA_new: 誰か聞こえるか？　仲間が何人か戻っていない。朝までにアフロプロムから帰る予定だったが、まだ姿が見えない。1時間後に捜索を始める。

entries.EN: Who invented morning, damn it... Been boozing all night long... Chef, that bastard, gave us a bad batch of vodka again... "Freedom", let's just keep sleeping. That raid against those "Duty" snobs can wait...
entries.JA_current: Who invented morning, damn it... Been boozing all night long... Chef, that bastard, gave us a bad batch of vodka again... "Freedom", let's just keep sleeping. That raid against those "Duty" snobs can wait...
entries.JA_new: 誰が朝なんて考えたんだ、くそっ……一晩中飲んでたってのに。隊長の野郎、また粗悪なウォッカをつかませやがった……フリーダム、寝てようぜ。デューティーの気取り屋どもを襲うのは後でいい……

entries.EN: I wish you saw the sunrise at Yantar, lads! This is wonderful! Both beautiful and scary... Nothing better than seeing snork corpses drifting calmly in the waters of the lake, gently lit with the beams of the newborn sun...
entries.JA_current: I wish you saw the sunrise at Yantar, lads! This is wonderful! Both beautiful and scary... Nothing better than seeing snork corpses drifting calmly in the waters of the lake, gently lit with the beams of the newborn sun...
entries.JA_new: ヤンターの日の出を見てみろよ、みんな！　すごいぞ！　きれいなのに、恐ろしくもある……生まれたての太陽に照らされて、スノークの死骸が湖面を静かに漂ってる。これ以上の眺めはないな……

entries.EN: The night has passed and I'm still alive! Allelujah!
entries.JA_current: The night has passed and I'm still alive! Allelujah!
entries.JA_new: 夜を越えて、まだ生きてる！　ハレルヤ！

entries.EN: The night is over. Time to welcome another day in the Zone!
entries.JA_current: The night is over. Time to welcome another day in the Zone!
entries.JA_new: 夜が明けた。ゾーンでまた一日が始まるぞ！

entries.EN: God bless! The sun is rising! Here's to a new day, and new struggles.
entries.JA_current: God bless! The sun is rising! Here's to a new day, and new struggles.
entries.JA_new: 神に感謝だ！　日が昇るぞ！　新しい一日と、新たな苦難に乾杯。

entries.EN: Hey everyone! Good morning, citizens of the Zone! Ha-ha!
entries.JA_current: Hey everyone! Good morning, citizens of the Zone! Ha-ha!
entries.JA_new: みんな、おはよう！　ゾーンの住人のみなさん、おはよう！　ははっ！

entries.EN: Oh, man... Has anybody got any remedies for hangovers? I'd kill for a jar of some cucumbers in brine.. Too much booze yesterday...
entries.JA_current: Oh, man... Has anybody got any remedies for hangovers? I'd kill for a jar of some cucumbers in brine.. Too much booze yesterday...
entries.JA_new: なあ……二日酔いに効くもの持ってないか？　塩漬けキュウリが食べたくてたまらない……昨日飲みすぎた。

entries.EN: Filya, you scumbag! What did you lace the weed with?! My head feels like it's splitting in half!
entries.JA_current: Filya, you scumbag! What did you lace the weed with?! My head feels like it's splitting in half!
entries.JA_new: フィーリャ、このクソ野郎！　マリファナに何を混ぜた？！　頭が割れそうだ！

entries.EN: Hey! Is it morning already? Where is everybody?
entries.JA_current: Hey! Is it morning already? Where is everybody?
entries.JA_new: おい、もう朝か？　みんなどこへ行った？

entries.EN: Okay lads, you do whatever you like, but I ain't going out for habar at this time. It's almost night already...
entries.JA_current: Okay lads, you do whatever you like, but I ain't going out for habar at this time. It's almost night already...
entries.JA_new: みんな好きにすればいいが、こんな時間に獲物を探しには行かないぞ。もうすぐ夜だ……

entries.EN: No, I'm not going anywhere. It's too late, monsters are about to come out for hunting...
entries.JA_current: No, I'm not going anywhere. It's too late, monsters are about to come out for hunting...
entries.JA_new: いや、どこにも行かない。もう遅い。怪物どもが狩りに出てくる頃だ……

entries.EN: It's sunset already... Head for shelter, folks, it's about to get dangerous out there.
entries.JA_current: It's sunset already... Head for shelter, folks, it's about to get dangerous out there.
entries.JA_new: もう日が沈む……みんな、避難場所へ向かえ。外はすぐ危険になる。

entries.EN: Look, guys... You wanna go seek excitement, then go... play with some bloodsuckers... out in the pitch black darkness.. All alone. Stupid cowboys..
entries.JA_current: Look, guys... You wanna go seek excitement, then go... play with some bloodsuckers... out in the pitch black darkness.. All alone. Stupid cowboys..
entries.JA_new: 刺激が欲しいなら、行けばいい……真っ暗な中で一人、ブラッドサッカーと遊んでこいよ。バカなガンマンどもめ……

entries.EN: So? Anybody got the balls to come out hunting for those pseudodogs? Better that than going to sleep in some dark tent, what if... this dark one... comes asking for water again?.. I'd rather take my chances outside. Who's with me?
entries.JA_current: So? Anybody got the balls to come out hunting for those pseudodogs? Better that than going to sleep in some dark tent, what if... this dark one... comes asking for water again?.. I'd rather take my chances outside. Who's with me?
entries.JA_new: どうだ？　シュードドッグ狩りに行く度胸のある奴はいるか？　暗いテントで寝るよりマシだろ。ほら、またあの黒いのが水をくれって来たらどうする？　俺は外で賭けに出る。誰か来るか？

entries.EN: The moon is about to rise... I'm not gonna make it back to camp before sunset... Anybody around, lads? I feel like I'm being watched.
entries.JA_current: The moon is about to rise... I'm not gonna make it back to camp before sunset... Anybody around, lads? I feel like I'm being watched.
entries.JA_new: もうすぐ月が昇る……日が沈む前にキャンプへ戻れそうにない。誰かいるか？　誰かに見られてる気がする。

entries.EN: Attention! The scientists send warnings about suspicious activity involving mutants at Yantar. Everybody, stay in camps!
entries.JA_current: Attention! The scientists send warnings about suspicious activity involving mutants at Yantar. Everybody, stay in camps!
entries.JA_new: 警告！　ヤンターでミュータントの不審な動きがあると科学者から連絡があった。全員、キャンプに留まれ！

entries.EN: Another day is over. And I'm still alive! Nice!
entries.JA_current: Another day is over. And I'm still alive! Nice!
entries.JA_new: 今日も終わりだ。まだ生きてるぞ！　いいね！

entries.EN: The day is almost over, yet I found squat today, nada! Won't be enough for so much as a loaf of bread.. Still, it's too late to go around scavenging alone, too dark out there... Anybody wanna join? We can watch each other's backs.
entries.JA_current: The day is almost over, yet I found squat today, nada! Won't be enough for so much as a loaf of bread.. Still, it's too late to go around scavenging alone, too dark out there... Anybody wanna join? We can watch each other's backs.
entries.JA_new: もう日が暮れるのに、今日は何も見つからなかった！　パン一つ買えない。だが、暗くなってから一人で漁るのは危険だ……誰か一緒に来ないか？　背中を守り合おう。

entries.EN: Folks! Is anybody in proximity? C'mon, join me! Better wait the night over in good company.
entries.JA_current: Folks! Is anybody in proximity? C'mon, join me! Better wait the night over in good company.
entries.JA_new: みんな、近くに誰かいないか？　こっちへ来いよ！　仲間と一緒に夜を明かそう。

entries.EN: Loners! Come, join us and wait over the night!
entries.JA_current: Loners! Come, join us and wait over the night!
entries.JA_new: ローナーのみんな！　こっちへ来て、一緒に夜を明かそう！

entries.EN: Does anybody know a safe place for an overnight stay at Yantar? C'mon, advise me! I'm here for the first time!
entries.JA_current: Does anybody know a safe place for an overnight stay at Yantar? C'mon, advise me! I'm here for the first time!
entries.JA_new: ヤンターで夜を安全に過ごせる場所を知らないか？　教えてくれ！　初めて来たんだ！

entries.EN: Another night at Yantar... Damn...
entries.JA_current: Another night at Yantar... Damn...
entries.JA_new: またヤンターで一晩か……くそっ……

entries.EN: Whoever you are and whatever plans you've got - I don't give a shit! I'm gonna booze all night long.
entries.JA_current: Whoever you are and whatever plans you've got - I don't give a shit! I'm gonna booze all night long.
entries.JA_new: お前が誰だろうと、何を企んでようと知ったことか！　一晩中飲んでやる。

entries.EN: Bros! Help! Some monster is stalking me in the grass! I ain't gonna make it on my own!
entries.JA_current: Bros! Help! Some monster is stalking me in the grass! I ain't gonna make it on my own!
entries.JA_new: みんな、助けてくれ！　草むらに怪物がいる。俺一人じゃ無理だ！

entries.EN: Signal unstable.
entries.JA_current: Signal unstable.
entries.JA_new: 通信が不安定です。

entries.EN: Critical error. Establishing connection...
entries.JA_current: Critical error. Establishing connection...
entries.JA_new: 致命的なエラー。接続しています……

entries.EN: Error! Transmitter calibration required.
entries.JA_current: Error! Transmitter calibration required.
entries.JA_new: エラー！　送信機の調整が必要です。

entries.EN: Connection lost. Try again later.
entries.JA_current: Connection lost. Try again later.
entries.JA_new: 接続が切れました。後でもう一度お試しください。

entries.EN: Error when receiving the message! Try again.
entries.JA_current: Error when receiving the message! Try again.
entries.JA_new: メッセージの受信中にエラーが発生しました。もう一度お試しください。

entries.EN: Connection timed out. Trying to reconnect...
entries.JA_current: Connection timed out. Trying to reconnect...
entries.JA_new: 接続がタイムアウトしました。再接続しています……
